The '''crystal impling''' is the third highest-level [[impling]] that can be caught in [[Gielinor]]. Players require at least 80 [[Hunter]] (or level 74 with a [[super hunter potion]]) to capture this type of impling with a [[butterfly net]], and optionally an [[impling jar]]. At level 90 Hunter, crystal implings can be caught barehanded. Capturing a crystal impling grants 280 Hunter [[experience]].

Currently, crystal implings can only be caught from rare spawns within [[Prifddinas]]. One may be found at a time on each [[world]], respawning at :00 and :30 (every half hour on the clock), and becoming visible 3 minutes afterward.

== Strategy ==
There are two main methods in finding crystal implings: '''looping''', and '''world hopping'''.

{{Map|group=prif|mapID=29|mtype=pin|width=400|height=400|align=right|caption=Crystal impling spawns in Prifddinas.|x=3263|y=6070|3290,6117|3307,6041|3210,6110|3213,6049|3237,6102|3308,6117|3240,6046|3214,6113|3290,6049|3234,6072|3240,6120|3234,6129}}

=== Looping ===
The player will run in a large circle around [[Prifddinas]]. Start by the altar in the [[Hefin Clan|Hefin District]] and run East, turning South at the [[Crystal tree patch|crystal tree patch]], West at the [[Prifddinas General Store|General Store]], then North at the [[Iorwerth Dungeon]] entrance. Complete the lap at the altar, use [[Vile Vigour|Vile Vigour]] or [[Stamina potion|Stamina potions]], and then hop to the next world. If you used Vile Vigour, remember to pray at the altar. If you find a crystal impling before completing the lap, hop immediately to the next world and hop only once you have touched that spot on the next lap.

=== World Hopping ===
The player will pick a crystal impling hotspot and repeatedly hop worlds, stopping only to catch any crystal implings on screen. Hotspots include: [[Portal (Player-owned house)|Prifddinas player-owned house]], [[Prifddinas north bank]], and [[Prifddinas south bank]]; however, the best spot is likely to be the Gauntlet portal in the north-west corner, due to the presence of 5 impling spawn points in the area around it. Because crystal implings only become visible after respawning at :03 and :33, it is best to begin hopping immediately following this time frame.

At current [[Grand Exchange]] prices, opening a crystal impling jar gives {{Coins|{{ImpValue|crystal|jar=yes}} round 0}} worth of loot on average, not including any received [[crystal shards]]. If using all crystal shards to make [[divine super combat potion]]s, including those from growing [[crystal acorn]]s into crystal trees with ultracompost, the value becomes {{Coins|floor({{#var:LootWithShards}})}}.

==Trivia==
*The names given in the crystal impling's examine texts refer to the individual names of implings found in {{RSL|Daffyd}}'s house in the Amlodd Clan district of ''RuneScape 3''{{'}}s Prifddinas after having caught certain types of implings. These are named after the team of [[Jagex Moderator]]s who developed Prifddinas in ''RuneScape''.
